site_description: Play Briscola against bots and watch how they think.
home_lead: Play Briscola against bots and watch how they think: the hands they imagine, the cards they weigh, the score they expect.
not_found_lead: The link is wrong or the page has moved.
game_bot_thinking_iterations: The bot is thinking: {done} hypotheses of {total}
game_last_card: The briscola is the last card
bar_forecast: The bot expects {bot} points of 120, you {you}; 61 wins
bar_taken: The bot has taken {bot} points, you {you}; 61 wins
reasoning_none: The bot has not played yet.
reasoning_exact: With the deck empty the bot knows every card and works out the exact result of each.
rule_greedy_lead: It leads with its least valuable card.
rule_greedy_take: It takes the trick with the card that brings it the most points.
rule_greedy_giveAway: It cannot take, so it gives the card that gives you the fewest points.
rule_hard_lead: It leads with its least valuable card.
rule_hard_assoOnTreOfBriscola: It takes the tre of briscola with the asso of briscola.
rule_hard_spareOnBriscola: On a briscola it gives its least valuable card.
rule_hard_assoOnCarico: It takes the carico with the asso of the same suit.
rule_hard_briscolaOnCarico: It takes the carico with its lowest briscola.
rule_hard_strongestOfSuit: It answers with its strongest card of the suit led.
rule_hard_spare: It holds none of that suit and gives its least valuable card.
